about: Cale Conley is an attorney who represents clients in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Cale Conley is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Cale Conley chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Georgia School of Law and graduated in 1996. Cale Conley passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
He represents clients with Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff issues in Georgia. He also represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Cale Conley has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
